scope: Repositories found in the same discovery pass but excluded or held after repository/system/license-quality review.

exclusions.reason: GitHub source page states the repository is empty; excluded because no source core or implementation is present.
Exact project root and GameTank target already exist in the 3,462-row catalog.
Atari ST/STE target is already represented in the catalog and prior core staging; a new Tang Nano port would duplicate the system target.
MSX2+ target already has software and FPGA core coverage in the catalog; excluded as a system duplicate.
Game Boy target already has multiple emulator/FPGA entries in the catalog; excluded as a target duplicate.
PICO-8 target already appears in the emulator catalog; this hybrid ARM-side implementation would duplicate the existing fantasy-console target.
NESTang is an NES FPGA core, a target already heavily covered by the catalog and prior staging.
Commodore 64 FPGA target is already represented by existing software and MiSTer cores.
Atari 2600 is already represented by catalog and prior FPGA entries; this is a Tang Nano derivative of the existing A2600Nano/MiSTer design.

Exact root overlaps with round-12/round-13 first-pass projects were excluded, including the previously staged Thomson TOMO, DECO Cassette, DECO156, Laserdisc, Killer Instinct, ZN-1, System 573, and Specialist entries.
Fork-flagged inventory entries were not promoted unless an independently maintained canonical upstream could be established; the 20 candidates are all non-fork roots.
README describes one specific Soviet TIA-MC1 arcade, Gorodki, with little broader multi-game documentation; held as a single-title discovery lead rather than included in this batch.
